purpose: Read-only verification of full official online originals for DSH sidebar browser; no replacement sample application, local installation, profile modification or server startup.
recommendation: Use the author-hosted online originals below. Both are reachable, so local deployment is unnecessary. Verify actual DSH desktop rendering and clipboard/export/storage operations separately.

projects.name: AI Visual Prompt Cookbook
projects.officialLinkEvidence: The official README links this domain and /site/ path as its online gallery.

http.readableContent: AI Visual Prompt Cookbook title, how-to-use instructions, categories and style index. Individual style pages expose the complete JSON in readable HTML.

fullContentEvidence.completeBoundary: The full library is 186 reusable style systems, each with its complete style.json plus examples and preview assets. Complete JSON includes prompt_template, environment_variables, examples values, style fidelity anchors, source exclusions and negative_prompt where supplied. A handful of example prompts or a short brief is not the full library. Family grouping can collapse cards without removing entries.

authorRecommendedUsage: Browse/search the gallery and select a style, example and aspect ratio.
Copy the complete style.json into ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or another LLM image workflow and replace variables/example values for the intended subject.
For tools expecting a plain prompt, use the gallery rendered text; short briefs are convenience alternatives rather than equivalent complete style JSON.

projects.name: Prompt Fill
projects.officialLinkEvidence: The requested GitHub fork API declares parent/source TanShilongMario/PromptFill and homepage https://aipromptfill.com; the fork README itself recommends cloning TanShilongMario/PromptFill.

http.readableContent: HTML title is 提示词填空器 (Prompt Fill) - 专业的 AI 提示词管理与管理工具. The application is a React SPA, so text-only fetch yields little UI text. Live application bundle and full JSON library were separately verified.

fullContentEvidence.completeBoundary: The current original is the upstream author-hosted full editor and library: 248 bilingual templates, variable banks, discovery/search, visual variable editing, preview dropdowns, copy, JSON import/export and JPG export. Includes four GIF templates and community adaptations with creator/source credits. The requested fork remains an older 84-template snapshot. Full original does not imply free image-model inference or guaranteed availability of optional cloud AI/short-link services; those operations were not invoked. Independent video editor/knowledge/UI Test pages were removed upstream in v1.1.4, while video templates remain. GIF preview remains animated, long-image export remains static JPG.

authorRecommendedUsage: Manage categories and create variable banks; browse or clone a template.
In the visual template editor, type / or { for autocomplete, or enter {{variable}} / {{key: value}} and drag banks into the prompt.
Switch to preview interaction and choose dropdown values or add custom options.
Copy the final prompt or export a JPG; use JSON import/export for backup and cross-device transfer.

User data is held in browser storage (IndexedDB; some README passages retain older LocalStorage wording). Folder storage and clipboard/export capabilities need verification in the actual DSH browser host.

localFallbackIfOnlineUnavailable.shareApiRequirement: Optional; without it the app uses long-URL sharing. No private share server is required for the editor/library.

embeddingEvidence.onlineOriginals: Both final app HTML GET responses lacked X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy at verification time. This is positive header evidence only, not proof of successful embedding or working DSH desktop permissions.

githubRepositories.consequence: Ordinary browser iframe embedding of GitHub repository pages is blocked by GitHub; prefer the online originals above. Native desktop webview behavior must be tested by lead.

verificationLimits: Read-only HTTP/content/header investigation; did not claim successful DSH desktop rendering.
